BoardInfo.doc: Board summary: name, description, counts and owner.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The board's name.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: The board's description; may be empty.

fields.name: elementCount
fields.doc: How many elements are on the canvas.

fields.name: memberCount
fields.doc: How many members have joined.

fields.name: owner
fields.doc: The owner's member id (account id).

Comment.doc: A comment pinned at a canvas point, with its replies.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Comment id, chosen by the caller.

fields.name: x
fields.doc: Pin position, canvas pixels.

fields.name: y
fields.doc: Pin position, canvas pixels.

fields.name: content
fields.doc: The comment text.

fields.name: author
fields.doc: The writer's member id, set by the contract.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.doc: Unix milliseconds.

fields.name: replies
fields.doc: The thread, oldest first.

CommentReply.doc: A reply in a comment thread.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Reply id, chosen by the caller.

fields.name: content
fields.doc: The reply text.

fields.name: author
fields.doc: The writer's member id, set by the contract.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.doc: Unix milliseconds; replies are listed in this order.

fields.name: identity
fields.doc: The device (context identity) this pointer belongs to.

fields.name: account
fields.doc: The member id (account) behind that device.

fields.name: x
fields.doc: Canvas pixels.

fields.name: y
fields.doc: Canvas pixels.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.doc: Unix milliseconds of the last move.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Chosen by the caller; use a fresh UUID. Writing an existing id replaces that element.

fields.name: data
fields.doc: What the element is, tagged by `kind`.

fields.name: x
fields.doc: Left edge, canvas pixels.

fields.name: y
fields.doc: Top edge, canvas pixels.

fields.name: width
fields.doc: Width in pixels.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Height in pixels.

fields.name: rotation
fields.doc: Clockwise rotation in degrees.

fields.name: fill
fields.doc:
Fill colour as a CSS colour (`"#ef4444"`, `"transparent"`); on a plain text
element, the text colour.

fields.name: stroke
fields.doc: Outline colour as a CSS colour.

fields.name: strokeWidth
fields.doc: Outline width in pixels; 0 for none.

fields.name: opacity
fields.doc: Opacity in percent, 0 to 100.

fields.name: layerIndex
fields.doc: Paint order; higher paints on top.

fields.name: createdBy
fields.doc: The creator's member id, set by the contract; the value sent is ignored.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.doc: Creation time, unix milliseconds.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.doc:
Last change, unix milliseconds. Between concurrent writes to one element the
larger value wins, so every write must carry a newer one.

fields.name: shadowColor
fields.doc: Drop shadow colour as a CSS colour; `null` for no shadow.

fields.name: shadowOffsetX
fields.doc: Drop shadow horizontal offset in pixels.

fields.name: shadowOffsetY
fields.doc: Drop shadow vertical offset in pixels.

fields.name: shadowBlur
fields.doc: Drop shadow blur radius in pixels; `null` or 0 for no shadow.

fields.name: label
fields.doc:
Layer name, a `/`-separated path: the groups, then the name. May carry client
extras after a U+001F character; keep them when renaming.

fields.name: cornerRadius
fields.doc:
Corner radius in pixels for a `rect`, drawn at most half the shorter side; 0 or
omitted means square corners.

ElementData.doc:
What an element is, as a JSON object tagged by `kind`: `rect`, `circle`, `line`,
`arrow`, `path`, `text`, `image` or `svg`, plus that kind's own fields.

variants.name: rect
variants.doc: A rectangle filling the element's box; `cornerRadius` rounds its corners.

variants.name: circle
variants.doc: An ellipse filling the element's box.

variants.name: arrow
variants.doc: A straight line with an arrowhead at its second point.

variants.name: path
variants.doc: A freehand stroke or a closed outline.

variants.name: image
variants.doc: A raster image stored as a blob on the node.

variants.name: svg
variants.doc: An SVG image stored as a blob on the node.

fields.name: points
fields.doc:
The two end points, `"x1,y1 x2,y2"`, in pixels from the element's `x` and `y`;
the arrowhead is at the second.

fields.name: naturalWidth
fields.doc: The image's own width in pixels, before any scaling to the element's box.

fields.name: naturalHeight
fields.doc: The image's own height in pixels.

fields.name: blobId
fields.doc:
Id of the uploaded blob holding the image; the contract announces it to the
board's members so their nodes fetch it.

fields.name: points
fields.doc: The two end points, `"x1,y1 x2,y2"`, in pixels from the element's `x` and `y`.

fields.name: points
fields.doc: SVG path data in pixels from the element's `x` and `y`, e.g. `"M 0 0 L 40 40 Z"`.

fields.name: naturalWidth
fields.doc: The SVG's own width in pixels.

fields.name: naturalHeight
fields.doc: The SVG's own height in pixels.

fields.name: blobId
fields.doc: Id of the uploaded blob holding the SVG markup; announced like an image's.

fields.name: content
fields.doc: The text itself; may be empty.

fields.name: fontSize
fields.doc: Font size in pixels.

fields.name: fontFamily
fields.doc: A CSS font family, e.g. `"sans-serif"`.

fields.name: bold
fields.doc: Bold weight.

fields.name: italic
fields.doc: Italic style.

fields.name: text_align
fields.doc: Horizontal alignment: `"left"`, `"center"` or `"right"`; omitted means left.

fields.name: vertical_align
fields.doc: Vertical alignment inside the box: `"top"`, `"middle"` or `"bottom"`.

ElementPatch.doc:
One element's change in an `update_elements` call. Fields match `update_element`'s
arguments; an omitted or `null` field is left unchanged.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The element to change; an unknown id is skipped.

fields.name: x
fields.doc: New left edge, canvas pixels.

fields.name: y
fields.doc: New top edge, canvas pixels.

fields.name: width
fields.doc: New width in pixels.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: New height in pixels.

fields.name: rotation
fields.doc: New rotation in degrees.

fields.name: fill
fields.doc: New fill colour.

fields.name: stroke
fields.doc: New outline colour.

fields.name: stroke_width
fields.doc: New outline width in pixels.

fields.name: opacity
fields.doc: New opacity in percent, 0 to 100.

fields.name: corner_radius
fields.doc: New corner radius in pixels; 0 squares the corners.

LabelUpdate.doc: One element's new label in an `update_element_labels` call.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The element to rename; an unknown id is skipped.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: The new label, as for `update_element_label`; `null` clears it.

Member.doc: A board member: someone who has called `join`.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Member id: the member's account id (64 hex), the id roles and ownership name.

fields.name: username
fields.doc: Display name the member chose.

fields.name: avatar
fields.doc: Avatar URL, or `null`.

fields.name: joinedAt
fields.doc: When the member joined, unix milliseconds from their own clock.

fields.name: usernameUpdatedAt
fields.doc: Unix milliseconds of the last profile edit; the newest edit wins.

MemberRole.doc: A member with their effective role.

fields.name: member
fields.doc: Member id (account id).

fields.name: role
fields.doc: `"admin"`, `"editor"` or `"viewer"`.

fields.name: account
fields.doc: The member's account id; always equal to `member`.

fields.name: elements
fields.doc:
The canvas. Writer-set guarded: only accounts holding a role mask
projected from `roles` (editors, admins) may write an entry, on every
node.

fields.name: members
fields.doc: One slot per account, written only by that account.

fields.name: comments
fields.doc: Guarded like `elements`.

fields.name: replies
fields.doc:
Every reply, keyed `"<comment>/<created_at:020>/<reply>"` so one
comment's thread is a prefix slice in order. Guarded like `elements`.

fields.name: cursors
fields.doc:
Keyed by DEVICE: a pointer belongs to a screen. Each entry is owned by
the account that wrote it.

methods.name: add_comment
methods.doc:
Pin a comment at a canvas point, or replace the comment with the same `id` (its replies
are kept). Editors only; the author is the caller.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin.

# Examples
```json
{"id":"9a8b7c6d-5e4f-4a3b-9c2d-1e0f9a8b7c6d","x":120,"y":90,"content":"Bigger logo?","created_at":1727000040000}
```

params.name: id
params.doc: a fresh UUID chosen by the caller.

methods.name: add_element
methods.doc:
Add an element to the canvas, or replace the element with the same `id`. Editors only.

The caller chooses `id` (a fresh UUID) and `layerIndex` (one above the highest in
`get_elements` paints on top). `createdBy` is set by the contract. For an `image` or `svg`,
`blobId` must name a blob already uploaded to the node.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin.

# Examples
```json
{"element":{"id":"5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90","data":{"kind":"rect"},"x":40,"y":60,"width":120,"height":80,"rotation":0,"fill":"#ef4444","stroke":"transparent","strokeWidth":0,"opacity":100,"layerIndex":0,"createdBy":"","createdAt":1727000000000,"updatedAt":1727000000000}}
```

params.name: element
params.doc: the whole element; `null` or omitted optional fields mean none.

methods.name: add_elements
methods.doc:
`add_element` for many elements in one call, such as a paste or an import. Editors only.
Emits one `ElementsAdded` event.

# Errors
Fails, adding nothing, if the caller is not an editor or admin or `elements` holds more
than 200 entries.

# Examples
```json
{"elements":[{"id":"5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90","data":{"kind":"rect"},"x":40,"y":60,"width":120,"height":80,"rotation":0,"fill":"#ef4444","stroke":"transparent","strokeWidth":0,"opacity":100,"layerIndex":0,"createdBy":"","createdAt":1727000000000,"updatedAt":1727000000000}]}
```

params.name: elements
params.doc: at most 200 elements; an existing id is replaced, as with `add_element`.

methods.returns_doc: The elements' ids, in the order given.

methods.name: add_reply
methods.doc:
Reply to a comment. Editors only; the author is the caller. Does nothing if the comment
does not exist.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin.

# Examples
```json
{"comment_id":"9a8b7c6d-5e4f-4a3b-9c2d-1e0f9a8b7c6d","reply_id":"1b2c3d4e-5f6a-4b7c-8d9e-0f1a2b3c4d5e","content":"Agreed","created_at":1727000050000}
```

params.name: reply_id
params.doc: a fresh UUID chosen by the caller.

params.name: created_at
params.doc: unix milliseconds; replies are listed in this order.

methods.name: bring_to_front
methods.doc:
Paint an element above every other one. Editors only.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin.

# Examples
```json
{"id":"5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90"}
```

methods.name: can_edit
methods.doc:
Whether the caller may change the canvas and comments.

# Examples
```json
{}
```
methods.returns_doc: `true` for an admin or editor, `false` for a viewer.

methods.name: clear_comments
methods.doc:
Delete every comment and reply on the board, for every member. Admin only. Emits no
event, so open clients see it only when they next read comments.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an admin.

# Examples
```json
{}
```

methods.name: clear_elements
methods.doc:
Delete every element on the board, for every member. Admin only. Emits `LayerReordered`.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an admin.

# Examples
```json
{}
```

methods.name: delete_comment
methods.doc:
Delete a comment and all its replies. Editors only. An unknown id is not an error, and
still emits `CommentDeleted`.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin.

# Examples
```json
{"id":"9a8b7c6d-5e4f-4a3b-9c2d-1e0f9a8b7c6d"}
```

methods.name: delete_element
methods.doc:
Delete an element for every member. Editors only. An unknown id is not an error, and
still emits `ElementDeleted`.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin.

# Examples
```json
{"id":"5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90"}
```

methods.name: delete_elements
methods.doc:
`delete_element` for many elements in one call. Editors only. Ids already gone are
fine. Emits one `ElementsDeleted` event.

On a large board a batch can run out of gas well below 200 ids (roughly 150 on an empty
board, 23 at 1000 elements); on that error nothing is deleted, so retry with half as many.

# Errors
Fails, deleting nothing, if the caller is not an editor or admin, `ids` holds more than
200 entries, or the call runs out of gas.

# Examples
```json
{"ids":["5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90"]}
```

methods.name: delete_reply
methods.doc:
Delete one reply from a comment. Editors only. Does nothing, and emits nothing, if the
reply is not there.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin.

# Examples
```json
{"comment_id":"9a8b7c6d-5e4f-4a3b-9c2d-1e0f9a8b7c6d","reply_id":"1b2c3d4e-5f6a-4b7c-8d9e-0f1a2b3c4d5e"}
```

params.name: comment_id
params.doc: the comment the reply belongs to.

methods.name: get_board
methods.doc:
The board's name, description, element and member counts, and owner.

# Examples
```json
{}
```

methods.name: get_comments
methods.doc:
Every comment with its replies.

# Examples
```json
{}
```
methods.returns_doc: The comments, each with its replies oldest first.

methods.name: get_cursors
methods.doc:
Every pointer's last reported position.

# Examples
```json
{}
```
methods.returns_doc: One entry per device that has reported a position, labelled with the account that owns it.

methods.name: get_element
methods.doc:
One element by id.

# Examples
```json
{"id":"5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90"}
```
methods.returns_doc: The element, or `null` if `id` names no element.

methods.name: get_elements
methods.doc:
Every element on the canvas, in paint order.

# Examples
```json
{}
```

methods.name: get_elements_by_ids
methods.doc:
Several elements by id in one read, such as the ids a batch event named. No size cap.

# Examples
```json
{"ids":["5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90"]}
```
methods.returns_doc: The elements that exist, in the order asked; unknown ids are left out.

methods.name: get_members
methods.doc:
Every member who has joined, with username, avatar and join time.

# Examples
```json
{}
```
methods.returns_doc: One entry per member; `id` is the member id roles and ownership use.

methods.name: get_role
methods.doc:
A member's effective role.

# Examples
```json
{"member":"<member id from get_members>"}
```

params.name: member
params.doc: a member id (account id). Anything else, or an id with no grant, is a viewer.

methods.name: grant_editor
methods.doc:
Let a member change the canvas and comments. Admin only.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an admin or `member` is not a 64-hex account id.

# Examples
```json
{"member":"<member id from get_members>"}
```

params.name: member
params.doc: their member id (account id), from `get_members` or `list_group_members`; they need not have joined the board yet.

methods.name: init
methods.doc:
Create a board owned by the caller. Runs once, when the context is created, with
the context's init arguments. The creator becomes the owner and the only admin.

# Examples
```json
{"name":"Landing page","description":""}
```

methods.name: join
methods.doc:
Add the caller to the board's members, so other members see their name. Anyone in the
context may join; joining grants no editing rights. Does nothing, and emits nothing, if
the caller's account has already joined (use `update_member_username` to rename).

# Examples
```json
{"username":"bot","avatar":null,"timestamp":1727000000000}
```

params.name: username
params.doc: display name shown to other members.

params.name: timestamp
params.doc: the caller's clock in unix milliseconds.

methods.name: list_roles
methods.doc:
Every member who has joined, with their effective role.

# Examples
```json
{}
```

methods.name: my_role
methods.doc:
The caller's effective role.

# Examples
```json
{}
```

methods.name: revoke_editor
methods.doc:
Take the editor role away, leaving the member a viewer. Admin only. An admin's own
admin role is unaffected.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an admin or `member` is not a 64-hex account id.

# Examples
```json
{"member":"<member id from get_members>"}
```

methods.name: send_to_back
methods.doc:
Paint an element below every other one. Editors only.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin.

# Examples
```json
{"id":"5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90"}
```

methods.name: set_layer_index
methods.doc:
Move one element to a position in the paint order. Only the elements whose index must
change are written (see `layer_move_writes`): renumbering the whole board ran out of gas
on a board of a few hundred elements. Editors only. Does nothing if `id` names no element.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin.

# Examples
```json
{"id":"5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90","index":0,"updated_at":1727000020000}
```

params.name: index
params.doc: the new position, 0 at the back; larger than the board is clamped to the front.

params.name: updated_at
params.doc: unix milliseconds, newer than the element's current `updatedAt`.

methods.name: transfer_ownership
methods.doc:
Hand the board to another account: it becomes owner and admin, and the caller stops
being admin (and so loses editing unless also granted editor). Owner only.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not the owner or `new_owner` is not a 64-hex account id.

# Examples
```json
{"new_owner":"<member id from get_members>"}
```

params.name: new_owner
params.doc: the new owner's member id (account id). They need not have joined yet.

methods.name: update_board
methods.doc:
Rename or re-describe the board. Owner only.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not the owner.

# Examples
```json
{"name":"Landing page v2","description":null}
```

params.name: name
params.doc: the new name, or `null` to keep it. An empty name shows the name the board was created with.

params.name: description
params.doc: the new description, or `null` to keep it. An empty one shows the description the board was created with.

methods.name: update_cursor
methods.doc:
Report the caller's pointer position to the other members. Open to everyone in the
context, viewers included. One pointer per device.

# Examples
```json
{"x":200,"y":150,"updated_at":1727000060000}
```

methods.name: update_element
methods.doc:
Move, resize or restyle an element. Editors only. Does nothing if `id` names no element.

Every field argument is optional: `null` leaves it unchanged.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin.

# Examples
```json
{"id":"5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90","x":300,"y":60,"width":null,"height":null,"rotation":null,"fill":"#22c55e","stroke":null,"stroke_width":null,"opacity":null,"corner_radius":8,"updated_at":1727000010000}
```

params.name: corner_radius
params.doc: new corner radius in pixels; 0 squares the corners.

params.name: updated_at
params.doc: unix milliseconds, newer than the element's current `updatedAt`.

methods.name: update_element_label
methods.doc:
Set or clear an element's label (its layer name and group). Editors only. Does nothing
if `id` names no element.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin.

# Examples
```json
{"id":"5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90","label":"screen/01 Sign in","updated_at":1727000030000}
```

params.name: label
params.doc: a `/`-separated path, groups first (`"topbar/logo"`); a `rect` labelled `screen/<name>` is a presentation screen. Keep any U+001F suffix the current label carries. `null` clears the label.

params.name: updated_at
params.doc: unix milliseconds, newer than the element's current `updatedAt`.

methods.name: update_element_labels
methods.doc:
`update_element_label` for many elements in one call, such as grouping a selection.
Editors only. Unknown ids are skipped. Emits one `ElementsUpdated` event naming the ids
that existed.

# Errors
Fails, changing nothing, if the caller is not an editor or admin or `labels` holds more
than 200 entries.

# Examples
```json
{"labels":[{"id":"5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90","label":"topbar/logo"}],"updated_at":1727000030000}
```

params.name: labels
params.doc: at most 200; each names an element and its new label, or `null` to clear it.

params.name: updated_at
params.doc: unix milliseconds, shared by every label; newer than each element's current `updatedAt`.

methods.name: update_elements
methods.doc:
`update_element` for many elements in one call, such as a multi-select drag. Editors only.
Unknown ids are skipped. Emits one `ElementsUpdated` event naming the ids that existed.

# Errors
Fails, changing nothing, if the caller is not an editor or admin or `patches` holds more
than 200 entries.

# Examples
```json
{"patches":[{"id":"5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90","x":40,"y":50}],"updated_at":1727000010000}
```

params.name: patches
params.doc: at most 200; each names an element and the fields to change.

params.name: updated_at
params.doc: unix milliseconds, shared by every patch; newer than each element's current `updatedAt`.

methods.name: update_member_username
methods.doc:
Rename the caller's own member entry. Does nothing if the caller has not joined.

# Examples
```json
{"username":"bot-2","timestamp":1727000001000}
```

params.name: timestamp
params.doc: the caller's clock in unix milliseconds; the newest rename wins.

methods.name: update_shadow
methods.doc:
Set or remove an element's drop shadow. Editors only. Does nothing if `id` names no
element. All four shadow fields are replaced; `null` for all four removes the shadow.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin.

# Examples
```json
{"id":"5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90","shadow_color":"rgba(0,0,0,0.3)","shadow_offset_x":0,"shadow_offset_y":4,"shadow_blur":12,"updated_at":1727000015000}
```

params.name: shadow_blur
params.doc: blur radius in pixels; 0 draws no shadow.

params.name: updated_at
params.doc: unix milliseconds, newer than the element's current `updatedAt`.

methods.name: update_text_style
methods.doc:
Change a text element's content or style. Editors only. Does nothing if `id` names no
element; on an element that is not text it changes only `updatedAt`.

Every field argument is optional: `null` leaves it unchanged.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor or admin.

# Examples
```json
{"id":"0d6f3a52-1b7e-4c9a-8e2d-5a4b3c2d1e0f","content":"Hello there","font_family":null,"font_size":32,"bold":true,"italic":null,"text_align":"center","vertical_align":null,"updated_at":1727000005000}
```

params.name: updated_at
params.doc: unix milliseconds, newer than the element's current `updatedAt`.

events.name: BoardUpdated
events.doc: The board's name or description changed.

events.name: CommentAdded
events.doc: A comment was added or replaced; the payload is its id.

events.name: CommentDeleted
events.doc: `delete_comment` ran; the payload is the id it was given.

events.name: CommentUpdated
events.doc: A comment's replies changed; the payload is the comment id.

events.name: CursorMoved
events.doc: A pointer moved; the payload is its device identity.

events.name: ElementAdded
events.doc: `add_element` stored an element; the payload is its id.

events.name: ElementDeleted
events.doc: `delete_element` ran; the payload is the id it was given.

events.name: ElementUpdated
events.doc:
One element changed (`update_element`, `update_element_label`,
`update_text_style`, `update_shadow`); the payload is its id.

events.name: ElementsAdded
events.doc: `add_elements` stored elements; the payload is every id, in call order.

events.name: ElementsDeleted
events.doc: `delete_elements` ran; the payload is every id the call named.

events.name: ElementsUpdated
events.doc:
`update_elements` or `update_element_labels` changed elements; the payload is
every id that existed (unknown ids are left out).

events.name: LayerReordered
events.doc: The layer order changed, or `clear_elements` emptied the canvas; re-read `get_elements`.

events.name: MemberJoined
events.doc: A member joined; the payload is their member id.

events.name: MemberUsernameUpdated
